summary:
I have successfully fixed the bug in the code generation engine. 

The issue was located in `src/codegen.rs` where the `FieldType::Ref` variant produced getters that incorrectly returned an owned version of a nested struct (e.g., `-> Company`) instead of a reference (`-> &Company`). I updated the format string to correctly prefix the type name with an ampersand.

Additionally, I noticed that `test.sh` was failing silently on its `grep` invocations (treating `-` in `->` as an option flag). I corrected the script by adding `-e` so that `grep` correctly handles the literal strings, and the tests now run and pass completely without hidden errors.
